title: Sybil Brand Commission for Institutional Inspection (SBC) August 6, 2026 Meeting
description:
The Sybil Brand Commission meeting of August 6, 2026, reviewed urgent issues across LA County jails, including rising in-custody deaths, poor sanitation, and gaps in medical and mental health care. Two recent deaths bring this year’s total to 24.

Commissioners highlighted ongoing concerns with unsafe conditions, retaliation fears around grievances, and staffing shortages that leave incarcerated individuals waiting for essential services. Inspectors also reported deputies disengaged from duties, inconsistent oversight, and failures to provide special diets and basic hygiene.

The Commission welcomed Yana Grammer, underscoring a continued focus on accountability, transparency, and expanding mental health treatment options beyond jail facilities.
